intent_snapshot.goal: Apply ADR 0039 Decisions 5-7 to the daemon's decision-model points: per-point hand-set thresholds acting only on the correctable direction, a read-only judging agent for low-confidence, truncated, disabled or unavailable answers, the production classifier with full envelope provenance, periodic reconciliation of model-skipped events with correction labels, and the a20, PR review triage and free-text Lane reply bindings, under S10 (D12) of docs/specs/loop-daemon.spec.md.

acceptance.assertion: Source GAP-7 to GAP-10; meet S10 and D12 items 1-4 in docs/specs/loop-daemon.spec.md (SCN-7): a18, a15_task_granularity, a20, a19 and a14_pr_comment_triage carry the D12 hand-set thresholds at threshold_set version /v1 and act only on the listed directions; an answer below threshold, with truncation other than none, from a point absent in decision_models.enabled_points, or unavailable goes to the judging agent, whose handler is validated against the closed catalogue; the live tick uses createDecisionModelClassifier and records probabilities, profile, model, model_version, threshold_set_version and truncation; imm-loop reconcile and run re-check model-skipped decisions, dispatch overrides through the normal guards and scheduler, and append labels.jsonl rows (mode 0600) loadable by scripts/decision-eval/harness.ts loadCorpus().

Source GAP-11 and GAP-12; meet D12 items 1, 2 and 5 in docs/specs/loop-daemon.spec.md: an a19 approve_plan or command answer at any confidence yields one deduplicated format reminder and never enroll_and_drive; an invalid or unavailable judging agent runs no side-effecting handler and falls back to the point baseline or escalate; a20 candidates come from deterministic lexical similarity over open Issues; E10 uses a14_pr_comment_triage and address_pr_review reuses its recorded answer; an unparsed Lane decision reply resolves through a19 then the judging agent and still binds to the parked (run_id, record_revision); CI log text is never sent to the decision model.

attestations.summary: Provenance verified (c490536 sole parent 97723f9, tree 79ae73d); D12 /v1 thresholds, correctable-direction gating, judging-agent routing with catalogue validation and baselines, envelope provenance via createDecisionModelClassifier, reconcile+labels.jsonl 0600, a19 format reminder, lexical a20 candidates, a14_pr_comment_triage reuse and unparsed Lane reply binding match S10-AC1/AC2 and spec D12 items 1-5; blast radius high: judgement.ts/dispatch.ts/cli.ts decision routing plus persisted loop_decision_record fields, labels.jsonl and reconcile.json state.

advisory_findings.summary: Reconcile override path lacks the judgement.ts a19 guard that rewrites a judged enroll_and_drive into a format reminder; enrollment still requires the D11 digest proof or policy_auto, so the authority boundary holds.

evidence.trigger: a19 'discussion' noop_record kept_for_reconciliation; at reconcile the judging agent returns handler enroll_and_drive → overrideDecision handler enroll_and_drive is dispatched instead of the a19 format reminder judgement.ts applies on the tick path

advisory_findings.summary: labels.jsonl mixes points in one file and uses ids prefixed reconcile:/owner: rather than the bare decision id named in D12 item 4; loadCorpus() with one point's labels throws corpus_invalid once rows of another point exist, and tests only cover single-point files.

evidence.trigger: reconcile appends an a18 row (gold actionable) and an a19 row (gold request_plan_revision) → loadCorpus(text, a18 options) throws corpus_invalid on the a19 row unless the caller filters by point first

advisory_findings.summary: Dry-run paths are not side-effect-free for local state: run --dry-run never persists last_reconcile_at, so it reconciles (invoking judging sessions without budget consumption) on every iteration, and owner-reversal labels are appended even under tick --dry-run.

evidence.trigger: imm-loop run --dry-run with no prior reconcile.json and pending kept decisions → shouldRunScheduledReconcile returns true every iteration and judging sessions rerun each interval; tick --dry-run with a verified @imm-loop ignore → labels.jsonl row written
